value.message: Town of Oakville's Learn to Swim has Preschool A Saturdays 9:00-9:30am and Preschool B Saturdays 9:40-10:10am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for ages 3-5 - their site says. I couldn't pin down the price. Fall registration opens Tuesday, Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I'll keep watching and text you when the price posts.
